findings.location: HTML, párrafo sobre la primera fuga
findings.source_quote: I was running like that until I came to a dirt road that lies about a quarter mile from our driveway.
findings.suggested_fix: «Seguí corriendo así hasta que llegué a un camino de tierra situado a unos cuatrocientos metros de nuestra entrada.»

findings.location: HTML, párrafo sobre el regreso a casa
findings.source_quote: We went back to our temporary home that night, and I crawled under the covers and cried out to God to show Himself to me.
findings.suggested_fix: «Esa noche volvimos a nuestro hogar temporal y me metí bajo las mantas y clamé a Dios que se me revelara.»
